question: What is the sports budget allocation for India for the 2025-26 fiscal year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹3,794.30 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Indian government has allocated a sports budget of **₹3,794.30 crore** for the fiscal year **2025-26**. This reflects a focus on enhancing sports infrastructure, training, and athlete development across the country.
 
• This allocation is aimed at supporting various initiatives under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, including the **Khelo India Programme**, which is a flagship scheme for promoting grassroots sports development and talent identification.
 
• A significant portion of the budget is expected to be utilized for preparing Indian athletes for **upcoming international events**, such as the Olympics, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games, ensuring they receive world-class training and facilities.
 
• The allocation also includes funding for the development of sports facilities in rural and urban areas to make them accessible to a wider audience and encourage participation in sports.
